name: uranium_redox_transport_prereg_v1_parameters
frozen: 2026-10-18, with Amendment A1, at the commit that adds this file; hash in receipts/uranium_prereg_v1_amendment_A1_freeze.txt
authority: A transcription for machine use. It adds no value. If it disagrees with the frozen text of v1 or A1, the text wins and the disagreement is a defect to report.
caveat: Synthetic column. Not a reconstruction of Oklo or the Franceville Basin, and no value here is an Oklo measurement.

status_vocabulary.source_supported: read in the named source at the stated location; for K_d, a sensitivity bound only
status_vocabulary.derived: computed from other entries by the stated formula
status_vocabulary.assumed_synthetic: a declared assumption of the synthetic column, not sourced
status_vocabulary.unverified: taken from a source that was not read; no entry currently has this status
status_vocabulary.declared_setting: a numerical or benchmark setting fixed before any code, not a physical quantity

physical_parameters.source: v1 section 4: chosen to match the fixture's vertical extent for comparability only

physical_parameters.definition: stationary organic zone, chi_org = 1 for x_a <= x <= x_b

physical_parameters.unit: mol per m3 of pore water
physical_parameters.role: normalization; the model is linear in C, so C and S scale with C0

physical_parameters.source: v1 section 4: the fixture's unsourced sandstone flow porosity (Darcy A2, phi_z)
v1 section 4: quartz-dominated sandstone, unsourced here

physical_parameters.unit: kg of solid per m3 of bulk medium

physical_parameters.context: v1 section 4: the Darcy v1 base case gives a domain-mean pore velocity near 3.8e-10 m/s at its hypothetical 1 m head difference

physical_parameters.definition: effective dispersion-diffusion coefficient of dissolved U(VI)
physical_parameters.context: docs/research/uranium_evidence_review_v1.md: Bai, Liu and Ball 2009 (abstract only) report an effective aqueous diffusion coefficient of 1.6e-10 m2/s for U(VI) in Hanford silt/clay at pH 8.0 and calcite saturation; it lies inside this range but is not its source

physical_parameters.definition: first-order rate of effective conversion of dissolved U(VI) into the immobile solid, inside the organic zone only
physical_parameters.source: v1 section 4: no read source gives a rate

physical_parameters.definition: pH at which EPA Table 5.17 is read; not a model variable
linear equilibrium partition coefficient, sorbed per kg of solid over dissolved per m3 of water
physical_parameters.role: sensitivity bounds for a synthetic column, never Oklo values

values.note: 63 mL/g, minimum at pH 7, EPA 402-R-99-004B Table 5.17, page 5.75

values.formula: geometric mean of 63 and 630,000 mL/g = 6,300 mL/g

values.note: 630,000 mL/g, maximum at pH 7, EPA 402-R-99-004B Table 5.17, page 5.75

physical_parameters.uncertainty: EPA (page 5.75) states its maximum curve is biased high, possibly by an order of magnitude or more, partly because some measurements may include precipitation; EPA (front matter) states that site-specific values are essential
physical_parameters.extraction: read from the table of the hashed copy; see receipts/uranium_prereg_v1_freeze.txt

physical_parameters.formula: 1 + rho_b * K_d / theta, one value per K_d, to the digits shown in v1

run_design.sweep: full factorial 3 v x 3 D_eff x 4 k_red x 4 K_d = 144 runs; all reported, none selected

numerical_settings.value: N = max(64, ceil(Pe_s / 2)), Pe_s = (v * L_col) / D_eff in binary64, in that order (A1.4)
min(0.5 R dx / v, R / max_i |A_ii|) with |A_ii| = 2D/dx2 + k chi_i (interior), 3D/dx2 + v/(2dx) + k chi_1 (inlet), D/dx2 + v/(2dx) + k chi_N (outlet) (A1.2)
production: I = 0.05 tau, m = ceil(I / dt_rule), dt = I / m, T_end = 100 m steps; B1: m = ceil(t_star / dt_rule), dt = t_star / m (A1.3)
Crank-Nicolson for C and for the S source, same weighting (v1 section 3)

checks.value: Ogata-Banks; R = 1, k_red = 0, v = D = 1e-9 m/s and m2/s, L_B1 = 64 m, t_star = 1.6e10 s, window 0 to 32 m, N = 256, 512, 1024; pass: both L2 orders in [1.8, 2.2]

finite-domain steady state; chi = 1 everywhere, v = D = 1e-9, k = 1e-10 1/s, L = 16 m, N = 64, 128, 256; pass: both L2 orders in [1.8, 2.2]; roots r1 = 1.0916079783099617, r2 = -0.09160797830996159 1/m (derived, v1 receipt)
absolute closure error <= 1e-10 x cumulative inflow at every output time after the first step, every run
k_red = 0: max |S| = 0 exactly, and ledger closure

variants (a) reaction sign flipped in the C equation, detected by ledger error > 1e-10 x inflow; (b) S source sign flipped, detected by S < -1e-12 S_ref; run in all 36 configurations with k_red = 1e-10; pass only if both are detected in every configuration and the uncorrupted model triggers neither rule (A1.7)
every uncorrupted run, every step, every cell: -1e-12 C0 <= C <= (1 + 1e-12) C0 and S >= -1e-12 S_ref (A1.5)

B1 problem at N = 256 with dt_0 = t_star / m_0, m_0 = ceil(t_star / dt_rule) (800 by the A1 arithmetic), dt_0 / 2 and dt_0 / 4; E_j = L2 difference of successive solutions over 0 to 32 m at t_star; pass: log2(E_0 / E_1) in [1.8, 2.2] (A1.6)

dimensionless_groups.Pe_s: v L_col / D_eff, with L = L_col = 16 m; distinct from the thermal Peclet number of Darcy Amendment A1

chronology.role: metadata for the research programme only; no date enters any equation, parameter or check of this column
